checks.description: Private-snapshot projection uses one six-column table with six captured and two daily rows.
Referenced platform template rows are not presented as tenant captures.
Configured group appears as a second line in the template name cell.
Single-page list still displays page size, page one, disabled arrows and actual count.
Captured scene filter shows only its own template.
Captured editor field order includes conditional tags, cron and observed content label.
Full synthetic text is preserved literally without executing its markup.
Scene-compatible enabled models and scope are used for candidate selection.
Cron help and disabled label options follow captured scene data.
Full long group prompt and observed fallback explanation remain intact.
Existing group starts collapsed behind its captured group label.
Tags start as a closed multi-select instead of an exposed checkbox list.
Tag search filters options while retaining the prior selection.
Tag multi-select keeps both choices and marks local form dirty.
Escape closes only the tag selector and preserves the editor.
Confirm persists a local edit and closes the form.
Editing the main prompt does not drop the configured group prompt.
Group prompt edits save independently of the main body.
A new configured group may intentionally have an empty body to use the main prompt.
Adding a group saves its identity and blank fallback body.
Captured removal action removes only its group and keeps the main prompt.
Captured-template edits do not mutate the old generic storage.
Shell close preserves dirty legacy-template edits.
Discard leaves the saved captured template unchanged.
Storage failure retains dirty form and prior stored content.
Switching to an unsupported scene hides tags/cron and clears incompatible model binding.
Scene-dependent state changes save together without replacing the full prompt.
Uncaptured content remains explicitly unavailable rather than synthesized.
Create stores an independent local template with selected model source.
Local deletion leaves daily templates and captured snapshot rows intact.
Opening a captured template cannot bypass a dirty daily editor.
Opening a daily template cannot bypass a dirty captured editor.
Another tenant uses its own sample and shows five captured rows out of twelve.
Missing tenant snapshot does not fall back to another tenant or report a confirmed empty list.
Login-blocked empty snapshots show unknown totals rather than a confirmed zero, and keep creation disabled.
Authenticated unavailable pages display their observed access evidence without implying login failure or zero templates.
An incomplete sample with no rows also keeps its total explicitly unknown.
A captured confirmed-empty list retains its actual zero count.
Captured zero tag options are distinguished from an uncaptured selector.
A captured tag scene offers group prompts even when no existing template or child prompt exists.
Switching scenes changes content label and captured scheduling help, and hides irrelevant groups without losing drafts.
Returning to the tag scene restores its help and child draft, with required group validation active.
More than twenty real sample rows use actual local pagination.
Second page contains the remaining captured record.
No synthetic DOM runtime errors occurred.
